command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $script=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'known_folder_rows_diag.py'; @'

import ctypes as c, os, shutil, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
from pywinauto import Desktop

ROOT=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")
EXE=ROOT/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
profile=Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"])
owned=ROOT/"logs"/"known-folder-artwork-rowdiag"
if owned.exists():shutil.rmtree(owned)
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer").mkdir(parents=True)
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer"/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_text(
 "schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=large-icons\r\n",encoding="ascii",newline="")
env=os.environ.copy();env["LOCALAPPDATA"]=str(owned/"localappdata")
p=subprocess.Popen([str(EXE),str(profile)],cwd=EXE.parent,env=env)
win=None
try:
    end=time.monotonic()+20
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        ws=[x for x in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=p.pid) if "flyExplorer" in x.window_text()]
        if ws:win=ws[0];break
        if p.poll() is not None:break
        time.sleep(.25)
    if not win:raise RuntimeError("window missing")
    left=None
    for _ in range(80):
        for x in win.descendants():
            try:
                if x.element_info.automation_id=="LeftFiles":left=x;break
            except Exception:pass
        if left:break
        time.sleep(.25)
    if not left:raise RuntimeError("LeftFiles missing")
    time.sleep(5)
    rows=[x for x in left.descendants() if x.element_info.control_type=="ListItem"]
    print("ROW_COUNT",len(rows),flush=True)
    for i,row in enumerate(rows):
        name=row.element_info.name or row.window_text()
        print("ROW",i,repr(name),flush=True)
        for img in [x for x in row.descendants() if x.element_info.control_type=="Image"]:
            print("IMAGE",i,repr(img.element_info.name),flush=True)
finally:
    if p.poll() is None:
        if win:c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(win.handle,0x10,0,0)
        try:p.wait(timeout=8)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:p.terminate();p.wait(timeout=5)
print("EXIT",p.returncode,flush=True)

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding utf8; python -X utf8 $script; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $rc
